title: Who pays for the AI boom? Texas communities are asking tough questions
summary: Behind America’s race to build data centres is a growing concern over electricity, water and land use. It’s a warning for countries, including India, that want to become AI powerhouses
llm_summary: The AI surge is spurring a rush to build massive data centers, and Texas residents are feeling the strain—higher electricity demand, soaring water use, and competition for land are prompting tough questions about who really foots the bill.
